events.title: Coming to Steam Next Fest — October 2026!

events.title: Major Combat & Progression Update
events.summary: Hello everyone!It's been a while since the last development update, and a lot has happened behind the scenes. Over the past few months I've been focused on expanding the core gameplay, polishing existing systems, and making every fight feel deeper and more rewarding.Here's a look at what's new!🥋 Brand-New Combat Mechanics⚡ Stun System🛡️ Counter Attack System🌳 Completely Redesigned Skill TreeNew Combat TechniquesUnlock powerful martial techniques including:🔥 Fire Fist👁️ Revelation Eye🌳 Wood Trunk

events.title: Skill Tree
events.summary: Hi everyone! I keep working hard so you can all have a great time playing KungFu Addiction. This month, I’ve been focusing mainly on creating the new Skill Tree.For a while, I’ve been thinking about the best way to let players customize their fighter’s progression in the way they prefer, and a skill tree felt like the perfect fit. Now, you’ll earn Skill Points by playing the campaign, and you’ll be able to spend them in your fighter’s skill tree to unlock new techniques and improve your stats.

events.title: Gameplay Update ⚔️
events.summary: 🥋 Hey everyone!First off, I just want to say a huge thank you to everyone supporting this game project, it really means a lot to me. I’ll keep working hard to deliver a fun and engaging experience for you all.Here’s what’s new:Body Endurance System – Each body part (Head, Body, Legs) now has its own endurance points.
